# tebib_security_group_rule (Resource)

One rule of a security group. Rules allow traffic; everything inbound that no rule allows is denied. Rules can't be changed in place: any change replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_security_group_rule" "ssh" {
  security_group_id = tebib_security_group.web.id
  protocol          = "tcp"
  port_from         = 22
  remote_cidr       = "203.0.113.0/24"
  description       = "SSH from the office"
}

resource "tebib_security_group_rule" "https_v6" {
  security_group_id = tebib_security_group.web.id
  protocol          = "tcp"
  port_from         = 443
  remote_cidr       = "::/0"
}

# Members of the group can reach each other on any port.
resource "tebib_security_group_rule" "peers" {
  security_group_id = tebib_security_group.web.id
  protocol          = "all"
  remote_group_id   = tebib_security_group.web.id
  ip_version        = "ipv4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` or `all`.
- `security_group_id` (String) Security group ID (`sg-...`).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Why the rule exists.
- `direction` (String) `ingress` (inbound) or `egress` (outbound). Default: `ingress`.
- `ip_version` (String) `ipv4` or `ipv6`. Taken from `remote_cidr` when not set.
- `port_from` (Number) First port (tcp and udp only). Leave out for all ports.
- `port_to` (Number) Last port of a range. Default: `port_from`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `remote_cidr` (String) Remote range, e.g. `0.0.0.0/0` or `2001:db8::/32`. Give this or `remote_group_id`.
- `remote_group_id` (String) Remote security group (same VPC) instead of a range. Needs `ip_version`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID (`sgr-...`).

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". ## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <security_group_id>/<rule_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_security_group_rule.ssh sg-abc123/sgr-def456
```
